command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/phase2-bidir-v4-install.log; cat /tmp/phase2-bidir-v4-install.log; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; A=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.BidirectionalMediaProbe prepare-abort-offcall"); printf '%s
' "$A"; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'probe=bidirectional-media-v4'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'prepared_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'active_after_abort=false'; B=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.BidirectionalMediaProbe start-offcall"); printf '%s
' "$B"; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'probe=bidirectional-media-v4'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'offcall_start_rejected=true'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'prepared_after_rollback=false'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'active_after_rollback=false'; test "$(state)" = "0"; rm -f /tmp/phase2-bidir-v4-install.log; echo phase2_bidirectional_v4_offcall_ok=true
